bearer.description: Access token from POST /api/auth/login (or /api/auth/refresh). Role + company are resolved server-side from the employee record when the token is issued -- never from the request body. Each operation's `x-roles` extension lists the role(s) allowed to call it.

message.description: Human-readable message; an array of field errors for DTO validation failures

login_id.description: employee_code (or the login_id assigned to the employee), case-insensitive

password.description: Never logged or stored; compared against the bcrypt hash

role.description: From employees.role_code at token issue time

company_id.description: From employees.company_id at token issue time

refresh_token.description: Opaque, single-use. Exchange at /auth/refresh before refresh_expires_at; a new one is returned each time
Opaque refresh token from /auth/login or the previous /auth/refresh (single use)

revoked.description: true if an active refresh token was revoked; false if it was unknown/already revoked (same response either way, no information leak)

role.description: From employees.role_code at token issue time

company_id.description: From employees.company_id at token issue time

dc_date.description: date column, serialised as ISO timestamp

job_id.description: service_jobs.id created when this unit was verified; null before

dc_date.description: date column, serialised as ISO timestamp

units.description: All of the group's units, ordered by unit_number

job.description: The newly created job (job_number allocated by the DB counter)

current_assignment.description: The caller's current assignment on this job
